title: Phone Slip: Rock River Gazette, "Did You Pay?"

fields.message:
"Hackers just posted what look like Ironcrest employee Social Security records + defense drawings. Did you pay or are you going to pay? Is this material for your shareholders? On the record, please."
ALSO 22:22: CHRO office wants OK to send all-hands at 22:30: 'No employee personal data has been affected, all three plants are fully operational, payroll is unaffected.' Board pre-read says: employee data under investigation; Rockford + Beloit affected.

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject on keeping one set of facts. Watch for the CEO approving one on-the-record quote from the fact sheet that matches the board pre-read and the 8-K draft. The quote should confirm the investigation and say affected employees are being notified, and it should say nothing about payment or materiality beyond the filing. The GC should stop the CHRO note before 22:30 and correct it (personal data was posted, plants are in manual mode, payroll is being protected), and the Audit Chair should check that all three documents agree.
